visual_review.method: Contacts contain exact source screenshot crops with diagnostic labels; no actor pixels recolored, reconstructed, mirrored or resized. The full screenshots remain unchanged. All104 phases were viewed by role and direction, and all16 AI/beam screenshots were viewed as full-frame contacts.

identity_and_direction: PASS: ivory/lavender mantle, small gold/purple eyes, central vertical pink frontal eye and complete attached tendrils remain clear in the real forest scene. E/W profiles and SE/S/SW front headings are distinct; NW/N/NE retain rear anatomy without the frontal central eye. No body separation, clipped meaningful tendril, wrong heading or degraded source identity found.
role_quality: PASS: two idle and three travel configurations remain articulated and grounded to a stable root; attack extends and recovers coherently, and hit configurations differ visibly. Three-stage death lowers the entire connected mantle into a flat low corpse. Normalized face/body size is coherent across roles; changing curl/lean does not create a gross model-size jump.

floor_resolution.derivation: The real sampler places the actor at clearing+(24,0), player at clearing+(-100,0), camera local offset(100,-32), viewport1280x720 and zoom2.6. Root projects to(640,360)+(24,32)*2.6. Authored bottom source anchors project to this same root because virtual foot160/256 contributes32*pixel_scale and profile sprite_offset=-32*pixel_scale cancels it.
floor_resolution.visual_evidence: The flat corpse lower contour reaches approximatelyy443 around this projected root. It reads as a complete resting heap on the map, without a detached floating upper body. The yellow patch around(625,490) is substantially left/below the actor root and is not its grounding reference. It therefore does not establish corpse hover.
floor_resolution.living_float: Living floating anatomy is source-established and remains coherent; no feet or new levitation accessory was invented.

attack_and_boss.evidence: All eight beam full-frame captures align warning/release corridor with the target direction and the visible body heading. E/SE/S/SW/W/NW/N/NE axes are distinct. Recorded projectile directions point toward the player, and every real AI/magic and boss-beam direction records contact.

recorded_gameplay.evidence: report.json contains actual production AI/combat/lifecycle observations; these are separate from the manually selected authored-pose captures in Main.

quality_reference: Prior static review compared the complete approved werewolf and seer_boss atlases. The real Main captures retain their structural standards: readable body and directions, attached articulated actions, intact progressively lowered corpse, and readable placement beside the existing player/map. No existing approved actor/assets were replaced for this review.
scope_limits: This is the per-actor actual Main gate; repository CI, APK/static Android checks and overall coverage remain root-managed gates.
